capabilities: Hide commands from right-click context menus
Match commands by exact name or regex
Apply hiding across all context menus (note, file explorer, etc.)
Import settings from the previous version of the plugin
Restyle hidden items via a CSS selector
extras: Archived in favor of Obsidian Commander. Requires disabling the "Native menu" option under Appearance, and hiding applies to all menus with that command name, so identical entries cannot be hidden individually.
intentEvidence: This plugin was initially a fork of phibr0's excellent customizable sidebar
motivation: The author reworked the settings of kzhovn's original code after removing the part now handled by Obsidian Commander.
problem: Obsidian context menus accumulate commands from core and community plugins with no built-in way to remove unwanted entries.

relations.evidence: This plugin is now archived, as Obsidian Commander includes this feature.
This plugin was initially a fork of phibr0's excellent customizable sidebar
The code for hiding menu items comes in part from Panossa's Mindful Obsidian

summary: Menu customizer that hides any command, including community plugin commands, from right-click context menus by name or regex.
